verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a law firm that provides legal counsel on fintech, venture, IP, privacy and employment matters, not a software product. Running it headlessly or in CI is therefore a category error for this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any executable software, CLI or API that could run in automation; the probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
